endButton: Give ON Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: This is the Japanese Institute of Sawtelle, JIS for short.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: It's been part of our community since the 1920s. Let's go inside.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: RANDY SAKAMOTO: Hi Sachi! Welcome. And hello to your friend, too.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Hi Randy! My friend and I are exploring Sawtelle together.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes, my grandpa Gisuke Sakamoto founded JIS with just four students who took Japanese lessons in his home.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: He wasn't rich, but he was always giving his money and time to the community.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes, it was a school and community hub.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: After the war, the JIS became a hostel for returning families.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: So it helped carry the community through hard times?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Exactly. For me, being here is about ON, or obligation.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: I feel a sense of ON (Obligation) to my grandpa to help the community.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: So ON means honoring what came before and passing it on.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes, you're quite right. We all have an obligation to the past.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Here, you've earned this ON (Obligation) token.
